Repair and extend the H3Act offline evidence pipeline in `/workspace/project`.
Its typed payload models, frame adapter and client replay must work together
with compressed byte expressions and the origin-capture audit extension.
Produce exact client receipts, lifecycle outcomes, HTTP/1.1 request boundaries,
body summaries, source-byte attribution and paired evidence diagnostics.
The complete input/output and timing contract is `/workspace/PROTOCOL.md`.
Runtime, dependency, submission-tree and syscall limits are in `RUNTIME.md`.
The initial project has real integration defects and unfinished extension modules.
Keep useful behavior while implementing the complete documented domain.
You may reorganize the project or add source/data files within the tree budget.
Submit the whole `/workspace/project` tree; its CLI entry is `main.py`.
Use CPython3.11.14 and the provisioned Pydantic2.12.5 dependency set.
Run `cd /workspace/project && python3 -B main.py < /workspace/sample.json`.
Run `python3 /workspace/check.py /workspace/project` for public sanity checks.
The program reads one UTF-8 JSON object and writes one JSON object, without args.
Public checks cover only small examples; all published domain rules apply.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
items.finalText:
All work is complete and verified. Final summary of the repair/extension:

**`modules/byte_program.py`** (completed stub) — compressed byte-sequence DAG (`Lit`/`Cat`/`Rep`/`Cut`) with eager length + exact fingerprint `sum((b[i]+1)·257^(N-1-i)) mod 2^64`; geometric-doubling hashes for repetitions (so `b"x"*10**18` never materialises); iterative range-hash/materialise/LF-search traversals; bounded eager splicing + lazily cached flattening (fixes a quadratic/1.9 GB blowup on definition chains); the restricted expression grammar (literals, earlier names, parens, `+`, `*`, endpoint-optional byte slices, AST depth ≤ 128); template compiler for whole `{{expr}}` templates and `<<random_string>>` → `sha256(seed/coordinate/occurrence)[:20]`, with expression and slice interning.

**`schema.py`** — removed the nondeterministic `random`/`secrets` eager expansion; strict pydantic raw-frame models (no coercion, no unknown member, exactly one header representation) plus compiled payload models that carry byte nodes; `compile_cases` builds the typed `FuzzingPayload` with the documented coordinates.

**`modules/clock.py` / `HTTP3_Just_Send.py` / `modules/fuzz_adapter.py`** — fixed the future/exception bug, the `NameError` that broke import, and the late-response waiter; implemented the documented same-time ordering (starts → events → pauses → timeouts), stream `4*i`, request-end/send-error rules, sleeps after request end, ignored datagram `End_Stream`, response retention until the first `end`, and `ok`/`timeout`/`closed`/`send_error` lifecycles with byte-exact receipts and counters.

**`modules/capture_audit.py`** (completed stub) — HTTP/1.1 capture reader that parses compressed channels without expanding them: CRLF/8192/8193-line rules, request line, 65536-byte/128-field blocks, Content-Length lists, Transfer-Encoding conflicts, length/chunked/none framing, chunk sizes+suffixes, trailer blocks with forbidden names, 20000-request/40000-chunk-line budgets, error offsets, per-part `committed`, provenance `owner`/`owners`, and all request/case evidence flags.

**`main.py`** — complete strict input-domain validation and budgets with `{"error":"input"}`+exit 0 for every rejection, single JSON object output, and a path bootstrap so it runs from any cwd/isolation mode.

Validation performed: public checker PASS; ~15k randomized differential tests against two independently written reference implementations (capture parser and client replay) — zero mismatches; brute-force verification of hashes/slices/LF-search on random compressed nodes; hand-verified receipts, fingerprints, coordinates and every boundary (line/block/field/budget/2^63 limits); near-maximum batch (8192 definitions, 50 000 items, 17 664 requests) in 2.8 s / 158 MB under the scored seccomp+rlimit profile.
